prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one landscape 1440x1000 first-viewport WEBSITE design-comparison sketch for the Gata Blood Bowl Sevens league tournament portal.
Primary request: festival-lineup typographic hierarchy transformed into a usable tournament portal for existing players consulting season, matches, teams and rules.
Style/medium: deliberately unfinished flat matte UI sketch, straight-on digital webpage filling entire canvas. Strong editorial typography and practical web structure.
Color palette: solid saturated #2547B8 blue background, #F3F7F8 as the only light ink. Only these two colors.
Composition: compact horizontal navigation at top, small Gata League wordmark on left. Beneath it a massive condensed sans Season heading with confident line breaks and spacing. Below the heading put compact aligned match-list rows in a wide main column with a narrower team/rule index alongside, aligned on a shared grid. Large typographic variation creates hierarchy. Current controls are simple inverted pale rectangles with blue greeked marks. Lists are compact and usable, never random cards.
Typography: one bold condensed sans font at strongly varied sizes throughout.
Text (verbatim): "Gata League" and "Season". ONLY these two text strings may be legible. All other text must be greeked indistinct short horizontal strokes or blurred abstract marks without readable letters, words or digits. No invented dates, numbers, names, fixtures, scores or season status.
Constraints: actual website navigation, current controls and structured data lists; not an event poster. Keep all content within first viewport. No device frame, photos, illustrations, icons, emblems, ornaments, random card tiles, gradients, texture, gloss, shadows or 3D. Flat matte unfinished sketch.
